QuestInfo.name: Misguidance
QuestInfo.0: Instead of finding the Flame of Revival, you were ambushed by the Black Wings. On top of that, #p1033227# is nowhere to be found. What's going on here?
QuestInfo.1: #p1033227# must have sent you into a trap. But isn't #p1012100# the one who sent you to him? It's time you had a little chat with her!
QuestInfo.2: #p1012100# said she never sent you a letter... Was it all the Black Wings doing? It was too perfect. They knew exactly how to draw you into their ambush.

0.0: Great. The Black Wings set a trap. WHAT A SURPRISE. You guess #p1033227# was working with them the whole time. Why can you never catch a break?
0.1: But #p1012100# is the one who sent me here in the first place! Was she tricked? No, that doesn't sound right. #b#p1033226# must have been a fake#k!
0.2: I need to tell #b#p1012100##k about this, before anyone else tries to fake letters from her.

no.0: She IS on our side, isn't she? The Black Wings probably want us to start fighting each other!

1.0: Your Highness! You're looking stronger than ever. What can I do for you?\r\n#L0##b(Show #p1012100# the letter and tell her about #p1033227# and the Black Wings' ambush.)#l\n#k
1.1: That's not my handwriting... Are you hurt?!\r\n#L0##bI'm fine. I'm more worried about how much the Black Wings seem to know about me. Everybody else has forgotten I even exist... #l\n#k
1.2: It's bad enough they know about #b#m101050000##k... The only people who know what you're doing are me and the Cygnus Knights. Hm... I'll see to it that the Cygnus Knights are careful with their information.\r\n#L0##bBe careful. If the Black Wings are after me, they'll be after you, too.#l\n#k
1.3: Thank you, Your Majesty, but please see to your own safety first. And from now on, let's only communicate in person.
